name: W30 Comment handler (FB + IG, organic + ad posts)

parameters.content:
## W30 Comment handler (community-response-lead, 4.14)

Triggers: Page `feed` and Instagram `comments` webhooks (ad comments live on the ad's effective_object_story_id). Plus three schedules: queue drain (07:15 SAST then every 5 min until 22:00), daily sentiment 21:30, hostile-thread check every 15 min.

Flow: signature check (automation/security/verify-webhooks.js) -> load rules/corpus/hide-words/prompt from disk -> dedupe insert -> context (ad, prior exchanges) -> fetch comment + parent -> regex/keyword pre-check -> Haiku classify (Sonnet retry on invalid JSON, then fail closed) -> rules -> optional Haiku draft + FAIS lint + shared guardrail (Sonnet redraft for objections only) -> hide / block / escalate / public reply / like / private reply -> log.

Credentials by name (create in n8n): `LV Supabase - n8n_app (least privilege)` (postgres), `Meta Page Token` (httpHeaderAuth, Authorization: Bearer <system-user page token>), `Anthropic API` (httpHeaderAuth, header x-api-key), `W22 Internal Webhook` (httpHeaderAuth).

Env (never in this file): REPO_DIR, AUTOMATION_DIR, META_APP_SECRET, META_VERIFY_TOKEN, META_GRAPH_VERSION, COMMENT_HASH_SALT, CTWA_BASE_URL, CONSOLE_URL, N8N_INTERNAL_URL. n8n must allow env access in nodes (N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false) and builtin crypto.

Dependencies: community/rules.json, reply-corpus.md, hide-words.txt, classifier-prompt.md; knowledge/faq.md and conversation/prompts/guardrail.md (optional at build time, both fail closed to fixed templates); community/comments-schema-additions.sql; W22 webhook /webhook/w22-alert.

Execution data: success runs are not saved (comment text is personal data). Hides run 24/7; replies only 07:00-22:00 SAST.

## Env + runtime dependencies (I-31c)
`ESC_REAL_KINDS` (name only in automation/.env.example): unset or false = escalation kinds are mapped to the old constraint (`sensitive` -> `human_handoff`) and the real kind is kept in `kind_requested`; set `ESC_REAL_KINDS=true` once migration 08 (escalations_kind_check with sensitive, dm_handoff, dm_after_link) is applied on the target database. No workflow change needed.
`conversation/guardrail.mjs` is an ES module loaded with dynamic `import()` from `$env.REPO_DIR` (default /home/node/repo) in the guardrail Code nodes. The n8n runtime must allow `import()` of that file from a Code node (repo mounted read-only at REPO_DIR; `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN` includes `url`). If it cannot load, the gate fails closed (`classifier_input_unavailable` -> fixed template), so a broken mount silences replies rather than sending unchecked text.

## Ingress split (I-16)

This workflow is the Meta `instagram` object ingress (callback URL /webhook/meta-comments, IG `comments` field). It ALSO receives Page `feed` comments forwarded from W02's `page` ingress. Two shapes are accepted by `Normalise events`: (1) `object: page`, `entry[].changes[]` with `field: feed`, `value.item: comment`, `verb: add`; (2) `object: instagram`, `field: comments`. A forwarded payload may arrive bare or wrapped as `{ body: {...} }` (both handled).

W02 must forward the RAW request body byte-for-byte with the original `X-Hub-Signature-256` header to this URL, so `Verify signature` (verifyMetaSignature(rawBody, signatureHeader, appSecret), positional) passes unchanged. Anything unsigned or re-serialised is rejected and alerted; there is no trust-bypass for internal forwards.

DB: comments (brand_id resolved from brands.page_id / ig_user_id, fallback code SMC), escalations.assigned_agent (text), comment_ad_sentiment, ads view.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'red', kind: 'webhook_signature_invalid', to: ['Jonathan', 'KG'], text: 'W30 rejected a Meta comment webhook: ' + $json.reason, source: 'W30' }) }}

parameters.query: insert into comments (brand_id, platform, comment_id, parent_post_id, author_hash, status, created_at) values (coalesce((select b.id from brands b where b.page_id = $6 or b.ig_user_id = $6 limit 1), (select b2.id from brands b2 where b2.code = 'SMC')), $1, $2, $3, $4, 'received', $5::timestamptz) on conflict (comment_id) do update set comment_id = excluded.comment_id returning (xmax = 0) as inserted, comment_id

select (select ad_id from ads where effective_object_story_id = $1 or ig_media_id = $1 limit 1) as ad_id, (select launched_at from ads where effective_object_story_id = $1 or ig_media_id = $1 limit 1) as launched_at, (select count(*)::int from comments where parent_post_id = $1 and author_hash = $2 and comment_id <> $3 and public_reply_id is not null) as prior_exchanges, (select count(*)::int from comments where author_hash = $2 and hidden = true and class in ('spam', 'competitor', 'abuse')) as prior_hidden, (select count(*)::int from comments where parent_post_id = $1 and author_hash = $2 and class = 'praise' and public_reply_id is not null) as praise_replied
update comments set status = 'skipped' where comment_id = $1 and $2::text is not null

update comments set status = 'queued', due_at = $2::timestamptz, decision = $3::jsonb, class = $4, hidden = ($5::boolean or coalesce(hidden, false)), text_redacted = $6, ad_id = $7 where comment_id = $1

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Action ctx').item.json.comment_id, $('Action ctx').item.json.due_at, JSON.stringify(Object.assign({}, $('Action ctx').item.json, { hide_done: !!$('Action ctx').item.json.hide, queue: false })), $('Action ctx').item.json.intent, !!$('Action ctx').item.json.hide, $('Action ctx').item.json.text_redacted, $('Action ctx').item.json.ad_id ] }}

parameters.query: insert into escalations (kind, ref_table, ref_id, raised_at, assigned_agent, note) values ($5, 'comments', $2, now(), $3, $4 || '; kind_requested=' || $1) returning id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Action ctx').item.json.esc.kind_requested || $('Action ctx').item.json.esc.kind, $('Action ctx').item.json.comment_id, $('Action ctx').item.json.esc.to.join(','), 'class=' + $('Action ctx').item.json.intent + '; first human touch within ' + $('Action ctx').item.json.esc.human_within_seconds + 's', $('Action ctx').item.json.esc.kind_stored || $('Action ctx').item.json.esc.kind ] }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'amber', kind: $('Action ctx').item.json.esc.kind, kind_requested: $('Action ctx').item.json.esc.kind_requested || $('Action ctx').item.json.esc.kind, to: $('Action ctx').item.json.esc.to, text: 'Community: ' + $('Action ctx').item.json.esc.kind + ' on a ' + $('Action ctx').item.json.platform + ' comment. First human touch due within 30 minutes.', deep_link: $env.CONSOLE_URL + '/community/escalations/' + $json.id, source: 'W30' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify($('Action ctx').item.json.platform === 'fb' ? { message: $('Action ctx').item.json.private_text } : { recipient: { comment_id: $('Action ctx').item.json.comment_id }, message: { text: $('Action ctx').item.json.private_text } }) }}

parameters.query: update comments set class = $2, public_reply_id = coalesce($3, public_reply_id), private_reply_sent_at = case when $4::boolean and private_reply_sent_at is null then now() else private_reply_sent_at end, replied_at = case when $3::text is not null then coalesce(replied_at, now()) else replied_at end, needs_human = $11::boolean, fais_risk = $12::boolean, hidden = ($5::boolean or coalesce(hidden, false)), sla_seconds = coalesce(sla_seconds, $6::int), text_redacted = $7, ad_id = $8, attempts = coalesce(attempts, 0) + 1, status = case when $9 = 'retry' and coalesce(attempts, 0) >= 2 then 'failed' else $9 end, due_at = case when $9 = 'retry' then now() + interval '10 minutes' else null end, decision = case when $9 = 'retry' then $10::jsonb else null end where comment_id = $1

select comment_id, decision, public_reply_id, private_reply_sent_at, hidden from comments where status in ('queued', 'retry') and due_at <= now() and decision is not null order by created_at asc limit 40

select c.ad_id, json_build_object('counts', (select json_object_agg(s.class, s.n) from (select class, count(*)::int as n from comments c2 where c2.ad_id = c.ad_id and c2.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' group by class) s), 'objections', (select coalesce(json_agg(o.text_redacted), '[]'::json) from (select text_redacted from comments c3 where c3.ad_id = c.ad_id and c3.class = 'objection' and c3.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' limit 20) o)) as stats from comments c where c.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' and c.ad_id is not null group by c.ad_id

insert into comment_ad_sentiment (day, ad_id, sentiment, themes, flag_media_buyer) values (current_date, $1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4::boolean) on conflict (day, ad_id) do update set sentiment = excluded.sentiment, themes = excluded.themes, flag_media_buyer = excluded.flag_media_buyer

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'info', kind: 'comment_sentiment', to: ['media-buyer', 'creative-strategist'], text: 'Ad ' + $('Parse sentiment').item.json.ad_id + ' comments: ' + $('Parse sentiment').item.json.sentiment + (($('Parse sentiment').item.json.flag_media_buyer) ? '. Negative-feedback-prone thread, media-buyer to review.' : '.') + (($('Parse sentiment').item.json.theme_alert) ? ' An objection theme was seen 3 or more times, creative-strategist to consider an ad or FAQ line.' : ''), deep_link: $env.CONSOLE_URL + '/community/ads/' + $('Parse sentiment').item.json.ad_id, source: 'W30' }) }}

parameters.query: insert into escalations (kind, ref_table, ref_id, raised_at, assigned_agent, note) select 'hostile_thread', 'ads', h.ad_id::text, now(), 'media-buyer', '3 or more abuse comments in 60 minutes, review the ad for pause' from (select ad_id, count(*) as n from comments where class = 'abuse' and created_at > now() - interval '60 minutes' and ad_id is not null group by ad_id having count(*) >= 3) h where not exists (select 1 from escalations e where e.kind = 'hostile_thread' and e.ref_id = h.ad_id::text and e.raised_at > now() - interval '6 hours') returning id, ref_id

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'amber', kind: 'hostile_thread', to: ['media-buyer', 'Jonathan'], text: 'Ad ' + $json.ref_id + ' has a hostile comment thread (3 or more abuse comments in 60 minutes). Review the ad for pause.', deep_link: $env.CONSOLE_URL + '/community/escalations/' + $json.id, source: 'W30' }) }}
